title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an exact `?package=` read answers its own package's item or 404, and a bare doc read beside two holders serves the environment's own entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #34247
Fixes #34248

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches a moved answer: `skills/**` teaches `?package=` reads of a holder or of its pair (objectstack-platform SKILL.md, "Customizing an installed package"), which do not move, and never the read of a package that holds no item of the name or the bare doc read beside a package-less entry

> **BREAKING.** Served answers become refusals: `?package=X` of a name X ships no item of now answers 404 (plain read and `/layers`), and the bare doc read of a name two enabled packages ship, beside the environment's own package-less entry, now serves that entry instead of the package registered last. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (in the changeset). No schema key, stored row or registry slot changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：带 `?package=X` 读取文档、视图等 8 类元数据时，如果 X 没有这个名字，返回 404，不再返回别的包的内容；`/layers?package=X` 同样只给 X 自己的层；保存数据源时的凭据沿用也只取 X 自己的代码层。两个包都发布同名文档、环境里又有一条无包条目时，不带包名的读取（普通读取、`/layers`、`/published`）返回这条环境条目，不再返回最后注册的那个包。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3/D5 规定精确地址只回答该持有者；裁决 6893582352 规定环境自己的条目优先。原来包名写错的作者会悄悄拿到别的包的内容；注册表和 facade 已返回环境条目，读取接口却返回最后注册的包，两边不一致。
- 风险与回滚：200→404 是收窄（BREAKING），只影响"包名不持有该名字"的地址；环境条目那一行是 200→200 换内容。持有者自己的地址、配对包地址、单持有者、无持有者的无包文档、对象类型、精确限定符已覆盖的类型都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`（`registryAnswerAtAddress`、`refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead`、`bareDocServiceCopyDisplacesEntry`）、`protocol-meta-layered-reads.ts`（代码层）、`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` 与 `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts` 的 `/published` 各约 4 行。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`，预期 29 通过、2 跳过；其中 `[#34247]` 组在四种装配下 `?package=gamma` 返回 404，`[#34248]` 两条在两种注册顺序下三个入口都返回环境条目。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**#34247 (exact address, X holds no item of the name).** PR #34241 made step 2 of `readMetaItem` decline the metadata service's copy of another package at `?package=X`, for the types the exact qualifier (ADR-0150 D5) does not judge. When X holds no item of the name, step 3 still read `getItem`, whose last tier is the first composite across packages, so the address answered another package's item. Now the code layers' answer at such an address goes through `registryAnswerAtAddress`: an item stamped with another installed package (the same test as `serviceCopyOfAnotherPackage`: not X, not a customization pair either way) is replaced by the registry's package slot for X, or by nothing, which the door answers 404. The family is the eight types PR #34241 enumerated: `doc`, `view`, `translation`, `field`, `seed`, `datasource`, `external_catalog`, `object_extension`.

**Aligned in the same direction (H2).** Both other readers of `readItemFromMetadataService(type, name, X)` showed the same shape and take the same rule:

- `getMetaItemLayered` (`/layers?package=X`): the code layer declines the service's copy of another package and reads X's own item or none. Measured before: `/layers?package=alpha` answered beta's `code` and `effective` whenever beta registered last, even where alpha ships the doc, and a package holding none answered a holder's.
- `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` (the save's credential carry-forward, read when no stored row is at the address the save writes): the same decline and the same registry answer. Caller paths that move: a save naming package X (`PUT /meta/TYPE/NAME?package=X`, its draft save, any save whose redacted credentials are carried forward) of a type in this family with no stored row at X. Of the family only `datasource` has a credential redactor, so only a datasource save moves: it carried the credential of the package the service kept (or of the first registered holder) and now carries X's own, or none when X ships no datasource of the name.

**#34248 (bare doc read beside a package-less entry).** Take two enabled holders and a package-less entry in the registry's bare slot (a stamp-less registration, or a hydrated row stamped with the `sys_metadata` sentinel). The registry exempts the bare doc read from PR #34036's refusal and serves the entry, and so does `MetadataFacade.get`. The protocol's plain read, `/layers` and `/published` served the metadata service's copy instead. The service keeps that copy by name alone, so it is the holder registered last. Now the environment's entry answers first (ruling 6893582352) on every bare door:

- `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` still refuses two holders with no such entry (409, as on main). When an entry sits beside two or more enabled holders, it now returns that entry.
- In that case `readMetaItem` step 2 and the layered read's code layer decline a package-stamped service copy (`bareDocServiceCopyDisplacesEntry`), so the registry's bare slot answers. In the layered read the entry is the code layer, and no package's artifact is looked up.
- With no overlay stored, both `/published` doors fall back to `metadataService.getPublished`, which reads the service copy directly. For a bare doc read only, each now serves the layered read's package-less code layer in place of a package-stamped service copy. These two files are outside the original claim surface; the coordinator approved the extension. They are `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` (dispatcher) and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts` (`RestServer`), each change beside the #32183 `mixedOwner` swap, about four lines each.

**Correction (recorded at the coordinator's request).** The first version of this card's commit refused such an entry with 409. It treated the entry as the copy of a row the layers decline, because a shipped doc is sealed and `isStoredEntryOfDeclinedName('doc', entry)` measured true. That reading did not apply: the layers never ask that predicate of a doc at the registry step, and they do serve the entry.
- Evidence: the ruling-6893582352 CONTROL in `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` ("the environment's own item answers first beside two holders", both orders), green on main.
- The 409 turned it red: 2 failures in the objectql suite at fa873f0ede.
- The CONTROL is untouched, and it is green again.

## FROM → TO

| Read | FROM (main) | TO |
|---|---|---|
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME?package=X`, X ships no doc of NAME (installed, or not installed), another package does; dispatcher and REST, both registration orders | 200, a holder's doc (first composite after the step-2 decline, or the service's copy) | 404 `RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND` |
| same address for `view`, `translation`, `field`, `seed`, `datasource`, `external_catalog`, `object_extension` | 200, a holder's item | 404 (item absent) |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME/layers?package=X`, X ships none | 200, a holder's `code` and `effective` | 404 |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME/layers?package=X`, X and Y ship NAME, Y registered last | 200, Y's `code` and `effective` | 200, X's |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, `/layers`, `/published`, two enabled holders plus a stamp-less bare entry; dispatcher and REST, both orders | 200, the doc of the holder registered last | 200, the entry (`/layers`: the entry as `code` and `effective`) |
| same, with a hydrated package-less row (stored row and its `sys_metadata`-stamped bare entry) | 200, the holder registered last; `/layers` the row as `overlay` over that holder's `effective` | 200, the row; `/layers` its entry as `code` and `effective`, the row as `overlay` |
| same name, two holders, no package-less entry | 409 naming both | unchanged |
| save naming X of a `datasource` with no stored row at X (credential carry-forward) | carries another holder's credential | carries X's own credential, or none |
| a holder's own address; a pair's address of its base's item; an item bound to no package at any address; `object`; any read naming no package (other than the bare doc rows above), including a bare doc read with one holder and of a package-less doc no package ships | as on main | unchanged |
| the covered types (`action`, `hook`, `job`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`) at a third package | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` | unchanged |

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, a new top-level describe after the #34040 one: the family pin (the eight types), then per type in both registration orders `?package=` of a third installed package and of a package not installed answers nothing, whichever holder's copy the service keeps or with the service holding nothing; one holder: another package's address answers nothing, the holder's its body. CONTROLs: a pair's read of its base's item and a package-less entry are served; every covered type is still the exact qualifier's 409. A datasource carry-forward pin with the real redactor (`hasMetadataRedactor('datasource')` asserted): in both orders and with the service keeping either holder or nothing, a save at each holder carries its own credential and a save at a package holding none carries none. Three existing CONTROL pins that asserted the FROM answer (`?package=C` of a view only alpha ships served alpha's) now assert the holder's own read and the 404.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts` (composed artifact rig, both transports): a new describe over four compositions (both orders, both ship or one ships): `?package=` of a non-holder (installed or not) answers 404 on the plain read and `/layers`; CONTROL: each holder's address answers its own doc on both doors (`code` and `effective`). CONTROL: with one holder, the bare plain read, `/layers` and `/published` serve that holder's doc. PR #34241's two measured-unresolved item-4 pins are flipped, in both orders: with a stamp-less entry and with a hydrated row, the plain read, `/layers` and `/published` serve the environment's entry on both transports, never the holder registered last; each exact address still reads its own doc, and with the entry gone the bare read is refused 409 again. CONTROL: a package-less doc no package ships is served on all three bare doors. The ruling-6893582352 CONTROL in `package-scoped-e8-readers.test.ts` is not edited, and is green.

## Verification

All readings are at head `72dc8ca25e` (origin/main `c934631723` merged), on a shared box, under the verify lock.

- The H3 rework itself was measured before the change on the same rig. Both entry states, in both orders, served the holder registered last on the plain read, `/layers` and `/published`, on both transports.

</details>
